headline:
ASHLYN
PUERTA.
label: GOALS. ONE MATCH.
question: Which Florida player should we cover next?
caption:
Four goals in one match. At 19.

Ashlyn Puerta scored all four in Sporting JAX’s 4–1 win over Fort Lauderdale United. The club’s October 16 report says she set a Gainbridge Super League record for goals by a player in a single match.

A Florida player worth following. Who else should be on our radar? Tell us the player, club and why.

headline:

THE TRAINING
DIRECTION?
label: WESTON FC / BOYS TECHNICAL DIRECTOR
detail: A role to know when comparing clubs.
context:
Weston FC lists Mendoza as directing
the technical side of its boys’ programs.
question: What do you ask a club before joining?
sourceLabel: Source: Weston FC staff page · Reviewed Oct 22, 2026
caption:
When you compare clubs, who decides what the players work on?

Weston FC lists Luis Mendoza as its Boys Technical Director and says he directs the technical side of the boys’ programs. That is a useful role to understand alongside the coach running your team.

Three questions to take to any club: What will my child work on this season? How do coaches give feedback? Who should I speak to if the group is not the right fit?

headline:
WHAT MIAMI
FC IS
PLANNING.
label: SEATS IN THE PROPOSED STADIUM
detail: Part of a planned 80-acre sports complex.
context:
Plans announced September 18, 2025.
This is background, not a new opening.
question: What would you want around a local ground?
sourceLabel: Source: Miami FC · 2025 plans + current club site
caption:
A local club is also a local business story. Here is one to understand in Homestead.

Miami FC announced plans on September 18, 2025 for a 15,000-seat stadium within Sports Performance Hub’s proposed 80-acre development. The announcement puts the whole development at $300 million — that is not the stadium’s price alone.

The club’s current site still describes Homestead as its future stadium. Its announcement says a move from FIU would happen once the project is completed. We have not verified a completion date or construction progress.

What would make a local ground worth visiting beyond the match: youth pitches, local food, easier transport?
